PracticeMode extension — test fixtures

Served on localhost, so automatic navigation is allowed without a consent prompt. Open a fixture, then use the toolbar popup or the on-page copilot. The automated versions of these checks are in tests/e2e/extraction.spec.mjs (npm run test:e2e).

FixtureScenario (requirement §9)Expected result
